scope: public Ferizy unified: trip.ferizy.com (API Gateway, 65 origins/140 routes) + ferizy.com classic (4 origins/4 OD/6 ODxShip + live fares); authenticated account/order/payment excluded
limitations: Ship schedule, price, quota, and availability responses are dynamic and depend on route, date/time, passenger type, and vehicle type.
A representative ship-schedule request was tested separately; exhaustive pricing would require a user-defined fare matrix and would create a very large, rapidly changing request set.
Authenticated account/order/payment/refund data was not collected.

Additional public master endpoints were probed: homepage/range/age, homepage/service-type, vaccine/self-assesment, logistic/form-parameter-setting, ticket/parameter (all HTTP 200 and archived under data/misc_public/).

Several other public paths returned 400/404 (homepage/layanan, homepage/verification, vaccine/reason without parameter, logistic list-* without required query/auth) — responses are archived but contain no dataset.
configuration/check is unstable (RemoteDisconnected) on this gateway at scrape time; response archived as error envelope.
